thread:
mike-support: FYI — ACME EMEA team just hit admission control repeatedly. They want a sustained low-latency multimodal demo for ~2h and asked for +8 GPUs in eu-west2. Opening thread for infra + support decision. queueing spiking.
jess-sales: @mike-support @leah-infra customer says it's a paid pilot and a successful demo will convert to Dedicated. They need us to get them through 13:00 CET. Can we do a temporary override?
leah-infra: what are the current admission rules and metrics? pls paste quick numbers.
mike-support: quick snapshot: queue_size=120, avg_wait=340ms, p95=1.1s, p99=2.4s. backpressure=true. AdmissionController logs: `AdmissionController: reject (limit)` — ACME is at concurrency 16 (limit).
sam-oncall: @leah-infra we can shape but that risks SLA for other tenants. Also the multimodal model they're using is memory heavy; forcing more concurrency could cause GPU OOMs. runbook warns.
leah-infra: options: (A) soft override increase per-customer concurrency to 24 for 2h + shape background tenants; (B) route ACME to a lower-memory model variant with smaller cluster slots; (C) deny and offer scheduled slot. Cost estimate for A: ~+$1,600/hr (eu-west2 burst pool).
jess-sales: they want A if we can put a circuit breaker in place. e.g., auto-revert if queue > 400 or err_rate > 5%.
mike-support: if infra agrees I need the exact admin command to run + rollback steps. Also we'll notify other tenants.
capacity-bot: deploy-bot: proposed command: `rlimits set --acct ACME --region eu-west2 --concurrency 24 --duration 2h --circuit 'queue>400 || err_rate>0.05'`. Requires infra approval and billing ack.
leah-infra: I approve conditionally: 1) run `--dry-run` first, 2) monitor p99 and GPU mem, 3) automated rollback at 5m if p99 > 3s. @sam-oncall can you own the rollout window?
sam-oncall: I'll be on shift at 12:45 CET and can watch it. I'll have rollback ready: `rlimits unset --acct ACME --region eu-west2`. I'll also pre-scale the eviction controller to reclaim model cache if needed.
leah-infra: running dry-run now -> deploy-bot reports: dry-run OK, predicted placement OK, projected queue drop ~-35%.
capacity-bot: deploy-bot: override scheduled for 12:58 CET. Live change will allocate from pooled burst capacity and tag usage for billing. Estimated billing impact: +3,200 USD for 2h.
jess-sales: :thumbsup: I'll confirm cost with customer and get a quick written commit. Please ping me with the demo outcome.
mike-support: thanks all. After demo we'll snapshot metrics and recommend long-term: dedicated pool or model-variant routing.
leah-infra: agreed. We'll record the change and run a short postmortem if p99 > 2s or if any evictions/ooms occur.
